name: TaskCompletionControl
description: The round control that marks a task Done in one press, or reopens a done one. Controlled: pass `checked` from the task's status and change the task in `onCheckedChange`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The task, by number and title: "#25 Fix onboarding copy". It stays the same when the task is completed or reopened.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element that names the task, such as its title.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the task is done. Only a Done task is checked; every other status, Backlog and Closed included, is unchecked.

props.name: disabled
props.description: For a person who can't change the task. Sets `aria-disabled`, not the native `disabled`: the control stays focusable and a press does nothing.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the state a press asks for: `true` to complete the task, `false` to reopen it. The caller changes the task.
